text_chunk: Scheme: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (West Bengal) (Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal). Benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,200 for SC/ST women and ₹1,000 for General/OBC women transferred directly to their bank account.. Exclusions: Women with permanent employment in Central or State Government, PSUs, or statutory bodies; Non-residents of West Bengal.

Scheme: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (West Bengal). Required Documents: Swasthya Sathi Card or Official Identity Proof, SC/ST Certificate (if applicable), Bank Account Passbook, Passport-size Photograph. Application Steps: Collect the free application form at a Duare Sarkar camp or Block Development Office (BDO) / Urban Local Body office. Fill in personal and bank details and attach self-attested copies of required documents. Submit the form at the Duare Sarkar camp for verification and DBT sanction.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) (Ministry of Finance). Benefits: Collateral-free micro-enterprise loans up to ₹10,00,000 (Shishu up to ₹50k, Kishore up to ₹5L, Tarun up to ₹10L, Tarun Plus up to ₹20L) for non-farm small businesses.. Exclusions: Direct agricultural crop loans; Defaulters to any bank or financial institution.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY). Required Documents: Identity and Address Proof, Business Plan or Quotation of Machinery/Items to Purchase, Last 6 Months Bank Statement. Application Steps: Visit the JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or any commercial bank/MFI branch. Select the Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun loan category and submit your business proposal. Receive loan disbursement directly into your account or vendor account.

Scheme: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka) (Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Government of Karnataka). Benefits: Monthly unemployment allowance of ₹3,000 for unemployed degree graduates and ₹1,500 for unemployed diploma holders for up to 2 years alongside free skill training.. Exclusions: Graduates pursuing higher education; Individuals already employed in public or private sector or self-employed with Mudra/state loans; Non-domiciles of Karnataka (must have studied at least 6 years in Karnataka).

Scheme: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka). Required Documents: Degree or Diploma Provisional/Convocation Certificate, SSLC / 10th and PUC Marks Cards (showing 6 years study in Karnataka), Ration Card or Domicile Proof, Bank Account Passbook. Application Steps: Log into the Karnataka Seva Sindhu Guarantee Schemes Portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in). Fill out the Yuva Nidhi application with your University Registration Number for NAD verification. Submit monthly self-declaration of unemployment status before the 25th of each month.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) (Ministry of Rural Development). Benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly states for construction of a pucca house.. Exclusions: Families already owning a pucca house; Income tax payers.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G). Required Documents: Official Identity Proof, MGNREGA Job Card, Bank Account Passbook, Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) Number. Application Steps: Visit your Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office. Verify your household details under the SECC housing deprivation list. Submit required documents and bank details for geo-tagged house sanction.

Scheme: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (Maharashtra) (Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra). Benefits: Additional state financial support of ₹6,000 per year (in three ₹2,000 installments) on top of PM-KISAN, providing ₹12,000 total annual benefit to Maharashtra farmers.. Exclusions: Institutional landholders and income tax-paying households; Farmers not registered under PM-KISAN in Maharashtra.

Scheme: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (Maharashtra). Required Documents: 7/12 Land Extract (Satbara Utara) and 8-A Record, PM-KISAN Registration Number, Bank Account Passbook, Official Identity Proof. Application Steps: Ensure active registration and e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal with Maharashtra land records. Verify your 7/12 land mutation with the Talathi or CSC center on nsmny.mahait.org. Installments are credited automatically to your bank account alongside PM-KISAN.

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra) (Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra). Benefits: Direct monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 transferred to the bank account of eligible women in Maharashtra to promote economic independence and health.. Exclusions: Families with combined annual income exceeding ₹2,50,000; Households with an income tax payer, regular government employee, or four-wheeler (excluding tractor).

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra). Required Documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate, Birth Certificate, or 15-Year-Old Ration Card, Yellow or Orange Ration Card (or Income Certificate up to ₹2.5 Lakh), Bank Account Passbook, Applicant Photograph. Application Steps: Apply on the official Ladki Bahin portal (ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in), Nari Shakti Doot App, or nearest Anganwadi/Setu Suvidha Kendra. Upload Domicile proof, Ration Card/Income proof, and signed Hamipatra (self-declaration). Complete e-KYC verification for monthly DBT disbursement.

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya (MAA) / Chiranjeevi Yojana (Rajasthan) (Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Rajasthan). Benefits: Cashless health insurance cover up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year for hospitalization, plus ₹10,00,000 accidental insurance cover across government and empaneled private hospitals.. Exclusions: Non-residents of Rajasthan without a Jan Aadhaar Card.

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya (MAA) / Chiranjeevi Yojana (Rajasthan). Required Documents: Rajasthan Jan Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Enrollment Slip, Ration Card / NFSA / SECC / Small Farmer Proof (for free category), Official Identity Card. Application Steps: Log in with your SSO ID on sso.rajasthan.gov.in or visit the nearest e-Mitra center in Rajasthan. Enter your Jan Aadhaar number to verify free eligibility (NFSA, small farmers, contract workers, EWS) or pay the ₹850 annual premium. Download and print your Family Policy Document for cashless hospital treatment.

Scheme: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare). Benefits: Short-term revolving credit up to ₹3,00,000 for crops, animal husbandry, and fisheries at an effective 4% p.a. interest rate on timely repayment.. Exclusions: Non-agricultural borrowers.

Scheme: Kisan Credit Card (KCC). Required Documents: Completed KCC Application Form, Identity and Address Proof, Landholding Record (RTC / Khasra). Application Steps: Visit your nearest Rural, Cooperative, or Commercial Bank branch or apply via PM-KISAN portal. Submit land records and cropping pattern details. Collect your Kisan Credit Card cum RuPay debit card after sanction.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) (Ministry of Finance). Benefits: Accidental insurance cover of ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or full disability and ₹1,00,000 for partial disability at a premium of just ₹20 per year.. Exclusions: Persons aged below 18 or above 70 years; Applicants without an active savings bank or post office account.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY). Required Documents: Savings Bank Account Details, Identity Proof, Nominee Details. Application Steps: Log into your internet banking portal or visit your bank branch. Fill out the PMSBY auto-debit consent form for ₹20 annual deduction. Receive your certificate of accidental insurance cover.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
text_chunk: Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) (Ministry of Rural Development). Benefits: Non-contributory monthly pension for Below Poverty Line (BPL) senior citizens (₹200 central share + state top-up ranging from ₹600 to ₹2,500 per month).. Exclusions: Above Poverty Line (APL) households; Persons under 60 years of age.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
text_chunk: Scheme: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS). Required Documents: BPL Ration Card, Age Proof Certificate, Bank or Post Office Passbook. Application Steps: Submit the IGNOAPS application at your Gram Panchayat (rural) or Municipal Office (urban) or State Seva Sindhu/CSC portal. Undergo verification by the Block Development Officer or Tehsildar. Receive monthly pension directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

Scheme: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana) (Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana). Benefits: Investment support of ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 per acre per year (split across Vanakalam/Kharif and Yasangi/Rabi seasons) for agricultural and horticultural farmers.. Exclusions: Non-cultivable barren land or commercial real-estate layouts.

Scheme: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana). Required Documents: Dharani / Pattadar Passbook or ROFR Title Deed (for tribal farmers), Bank Account Passbook, Official Identity Proof. Application Steps: Contact your cluster Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) in your village/mandal in Telangana. Submit copies of your Pattadar Passbook and bank account details before the crop season. Receive direct seasonal credit into your bank account.

Scheme: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka State Scheme) (Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka). Benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 transferred directly via DBT to the woman head of the family listed on the household Ration Card.. Exclusions: Families where the woman head or her husband is an Income Tax or GST payer; Non-residents of Karnataka.

Scheme: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka State Scheme). Required Documents: Antyodaya, BPL, or APL Ration Card showing woman as family head, Identity Proof of Woman Head and Spouse, Bank Account Passbook. Application Steps: Apply on the Karnataka Seva Sindhu Guarantee Schemes Portal or visit a Bangalore One / Karnataka One / Bapuji Seva Kendra center. Provide Ration Card number and verify family details. Receive ₹2,000 monthly directly into your bank account.

scheme_name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu State Scheme)
text_chunk: Scheme: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu State Scheme) (Special Programme Implementation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu). Benefits: Monthly basic income grant of ₹1,000 deposited directly into the bank account of eligible women family heads across Tamil Nadu.. Exclusions: Households owning a four-wheeler or consuming over 3,600 units of electricity per year; Families with annual income above ₹2,50,000.

scheme_name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu State Scheme)
text_chunk: Scheme: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Tamil Nadu State Scheme). Required Documents: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Ration Card, Identity Proof, Bank Passbook. Application Steps: Attend the local Ration Shop registration camp or visit an e-Sevai / Common Service Centre in Tamil Nadu. Complete biometric verification with your Smart Ration Card. Receive ₹1,000 on the 15th of every month via DBT.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) (Ministry of Women and Child Development). Benefits: Maternity cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for the first living child, and ₹6,000 for the second child if it is a girl.. Exclusions: Women in regular employment with Central/State Government or PSUs.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY). Required Documents: MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card, Identity Proof, Bank Account Passbook. Application Steps: Register your pregnancy at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility. Submit the PMMVY Form 1-A online or through an ASHA/Anganwadi worker. Complete child immunization to receive the final installment.

scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
text_chunk: Scheme: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu) (Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu). Benefits: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,000 paid directly into the bank account of girl students pursuing Undergraduate Degree, Diploma, or ITI courses until completion.. Exclusions: Students who studied Class 6 to 12 in private unaided schools (unless under RTE quota); Students pursuing distance or correspondence education.

scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
text_chunk: Scheme: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu). Required Documents: Class 6 to 12 Government School Study Certificate / EMIS ID, College Bonafide Certificate, Student Bank Account Passbook, Official Identity Proof. Application Steps: Apply online through the Pudhumai Penn portal (penkalvi.tn.gov.in) via your college nodal officer. Enter your EMIS school number to auto-verify Class 6 to 12 government school education. Complete college verification to receive ₹1,000 monthly via DBT.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) (Ministry of Labour and Employment). Benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining age 60 for unorganized workers (rickshaw pullers, street vendors, construction workers, domestic workers) with 50% government co-contribution.. Exclusions: Workers covered under EPFO, ESIC, or NPS; Income tax payers; Monthly income above ₹15,000.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM). Required Documents: e-Shram Card or Identity Proof, Savings Bank Account Passbook with IFSC, Active Mobile Phone. Application Steps: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with your bank passbook. Complete biometric verification and pay the first monthly contribution in cash. Receive your printed PM-SYM Pension Card immediately.

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) (Ministry of Finance). Benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60 for unorganized sector workers, based on monthly contribution amount.. Exclusions: Income tax payers; Persons below 18 or above 40 years.

Scheme: Atal Pension Yojana (APY). Required Documents: Active Savings Bank or Post Office Account, Identity Proof, Mobile Number. Application Steps: Approach the bank branch or post office where your savings account is held. Fill the APY registration form and select your pension slab (₹1,000 to ₹5,000). Maintain monthly balance for auto-debit contribution.

Scheme: Krishak Bandhu Scheme (West Bengal) (Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal). Benefits: Financial assistance of ₹4,000 to ₹10,000 per year in two installments (Kharif and Rabi) for cultivation, plus ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover for farmers aged 18-60.. Exclusions: Non-cultivators without RoR (Porcha), Patta, or registered Bargadar record.

Scheme: Krishak Bandhu Scheme (West Bengal). Required Documents: Record of Rights (RoR / Porcha) or Bargadar Certificate, Voter ID Card, Bank Account Passbook, Active Mobile Number. Application Steps: Visit a Duare Sarkar camp or Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) Block Office in West Bengal. Submit the Krishak Bandhu enrollment form with land Porcha and bank passbook. Check approval status on krishakbandhu.net.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
text_chunk: Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare). Benefits: Health insurance cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization at empaneled public and private hospitals.. Exclusions: Households paying income tax or owning a four-wheeler vehicle.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
text_chunk: Scheme: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY). Required Documents: Government-issued Identity Card, Ration Card or Family Income Certificate, Active Mobile Number. Application Steps: Check eligibility on the official PM-JAY portal or at an empaneled hospital. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Ayushman Mitra desk with family ID documents. Complete verification to receive your Ayushman Card.

Scheme: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment). Benefits: Full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable tuition fees plus an academic allowance of ₹2,500 to ₹13,500 per year for Scheduled Caste students studying in Class 11 through PhD.. Exclusions: Students belonging to categories other than Scheduled Caste; Family annual income above ₹2,50,000.

Scheme: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students. Required Documents: SC Caste Certificate, Family Annual Income Certificate, Previous Year Marksheet and Fee Receipt, Student Bank Account Passbook. Application Steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) and fill out the Post-Matric Scholarship application. Upload Caste and Income certificates for institute verification.

Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) (Ministry of Finance). Benefits: High-interest (8.2% p.a.) tax-free savings account for a girl child's education and marriage expenses, with Section 80C tax deduction up to ₹1,50,000.. Exclusions: Girl child above 10 years of age; More than two girl children per family (unless twins/triplets).

Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY). Required Documents: Birth Certificate of Girl Child, Parent/Guardian Identity and Address Proof, Passport-size photographs. Application Steps: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch. Fill out the Sukanya Samriddhi Account opening form (Form SSA-1). Submit the birth certificate and guardian ID with an initial deposit (minimum ₹250).

scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
text_chunk: Scheme: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Ministry of Education). Benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study (up to 4 years) for girl students admitted to first-year AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses.. Exclusions: Male students; Families with annual income over ₹8,00,000.

scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
text_chunk: Scheme: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students. Required Documents: 10th and 12th Marksheets, AICTE College Admission Letter, Family Income Certificate, Bank Passbook. Application Steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under AICTE schemes. Fill the Pragati Scholarship form and upload admission and income certificates. Get online verification completed by your technical institution.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare). Benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance against natural calamities, pests, and diseases at very low farmer premium (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops).. Exclusions: Crop losses caused by war, nuclear risks, or malicious damage.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). Required Documents: Land Possession Certificate / Khasra paper or Tenancy Agreement, Sowing Certificate, Bank Account Passbook. Application Steps: Apply on pmfby.gov.in, through your crop loan bank, or at a Common Service Centre (CSC) before the seasonal cut-off date. Pay the nominal 1.5% to 2% farmer share premium. Report any localized crop loss within 72 hours via the Crop Insurance App.

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
text_chunk: Scheme: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs). Benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹10,000 for 1 year (expandable to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayment) with a 7% interest subsidy.. Exclusions: Non-vending business owners with permanent commercial shops.

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
text_chunk: Scheme: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi). Required Documents: Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body (ULB), Voter ID, Driving License, MNREGA Card, or PAN Card, Bank Account Passbook. Application Steps: Visit the official PM SVANidhi portal or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Verify your mobile number and check your vendor survey category status. Fill out the online loan application form, upload your Vending Certificate/ID, and select a preferred lender.

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh) (Department of Women and Child Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh). Benefits: Conditional cash transfer totaling ₹25,000 across 6 milestone stages from a girl child's birth, immunization, and Class 1/6/9 enrollment up to graduation/diploma admission.. Exclusions: Families with annual income exceeding ₹3,00,000; More than two girls per family.

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh). Required Documents: Uttar Pradesh Residence Proof (Ration Card / Voter ID), Birth Certificate or School/College Admission Certificate, Family Income Certificate / Self-Declaration, Mother/Father/Applicant Bank Passbook. Application Steps: Register on the UP Kanya Sumangala Portal (mksy.up.gov.in) under Citizen Service Portal. Select the applicable stage (Stage 1 to Stage 6) and upload birth/vaccination or school admission proofs. After Block/District Probation Officer verification, funds are transferred directly via PFMS.

Scheme: PM Vishwakarma Scheme (Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises). Benefits: ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3,00,000 at 5% concessional interest.. Exclusions: Government employees and their family members; Applicants who already availed PMEGP or Mudra loans in the last 5 years.

Scheme: PM Vishwakarma Scheme. Required Documents: Identity Proof, Ration Card, Active Bank Account Passbook, Mobile Number. Application Steps: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) to register on the PM Vishwakarma portal. Complete three-stage verification by Gram Panchayat/ULB and District Committee. Receive your PM Vishwakarma Digital ID and apply for toolkit incentive and credit.

Scheme: SUBHADRA Yojana (Odisha) (Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Odisha). Benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year in two equal installments of ₹5,000 (on Raksha Bandhan and International Women's Day) totaling ₹50,000 over 5 years, plus a SUBHADRA Debit Card.. Exclusions: Families with annual income above ₹2,50,000; Households owning more than 5 acres of irrigated land or 10 acres of non-irrigated land; Income tax payers or regular government employees.

Scheme: SUBHADRA Yojana (Odisha). Required Documents: Odisha Ration Card (NFSA / SFSS) or Residence Proof, Official Identity Card, Single-Holder DBT-Enabled Bank Account, Mobile Number. Application Steps: Obtain the free printed SUBHADRA form from an Anganwadi Centre, Block Office, or Mo Seba Kendra. Submit the filled form at the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Mo Seba Kendra for online digitization on subhadra.odisha.gov.in. Complete biometric e-KYC to receive ₹5,000 bi-annual installments.

scheme_name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
text_chunk: Scheme: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment). Benefits: Academic allowance and tuition fee grant ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 per year for OBC, EBC, and DNT students pursuing post-secondary education.. Exclusions: Family income exceeding ₹2,50,000 per annum; Students pursuing correspondence/distance courses.

scheme_name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
text_chunk: Scheme: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students. Required Documents: OBC/EBC/DNT Certificate, Income Certificate, Bonafide Student Certificate, Bank Account Passbook. Application Steps: Log into the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Select PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship and upload academic and income proofs. Submit copy of application to your school or college nodal officer.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY) (Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas). Benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection with financial support of ₹1,600, plus a free first LPG cylinder refill and hotplate stove, and ₹300 per cylinder targeted subsidy.. Exclusions: Households that already have an existing LPG connection; Male applicants.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY). Required Documents: BPL Ration Card or Self-Declaration for Migrant Households, Identity and Address Proof, Bank Account Passbook. Application Steps: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or visit the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas). Submit the KYC form along with Ration Card/Deprivation Declaration. Collect your LPG stove and cylinder after connection release.

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh) (Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh). Benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 transferred directly into the bank accounts of eligible women in Madhya Pradesh for health, nutrition, and economic self-reliance.. Exclusions: Unmarried women (except widows, divorcees, and abandoned women); Families owning more than 5 acres of agricultural land or paying income tax.

Scheme: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh). Required Documents: Samagra Family and Member ID, Official Identity Card, DBT-Enabled Bank Account Passbook, Active Mobile Number. Application Steps: Visit your Gram Panchayat, Ward Office, or designated camp in Madhya Pradesh with your Samagra ID. Complete live photograph capture and online form entry on cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in. Collect your printed acknowledgment receipt and track monthly payments online.

Scheme: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal) (Department of Women Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal). Benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 for unmarried girls aged 13-18 in school (K1) and a one-time grant of ₹25,000 upon turning 18 if continuing education or vocational training (K2).. Exclusions: Married applicants; Families with annual income exceeding ₹1,20,000 (waived for physically challenged or orphaned girls).

Scheme: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal). Required Documents: Birth Certificate, Unmarried Declaration Certificate, Family Income Certificate, School/College Enrollment Certificate, Bank Passbook. Application Steps: Obtain the K1 or K2 application form from the Head of your Educational Institution. Submit the completed form along with birth, income, and unmarried certificates to your school/college. Track application status on the official Kanyashree portal (wbkanyashree.gov.in).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
text_chunk: Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) (Ministry of Finance). Benefits: One-year renewable term life insurance cover of ₹2,00,000 for death due to any reason at an annual premium of ₹436.. Exclusions: New enrollees above 50 years of age.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
text_chunk: Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY). Required Documents: Savings Bank Account Passbook, Official Identity Proof, Signed Auto-Debit Consent Form. Application Steps: Visit your savings bank branch or net banking portal. Submit the PMJJBY enrollment cum auto-debit mandate form. Ensure sufficient balance for the ₹436 annual premium deduction.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare). Benefits: Financial support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months directly into the farmer's bank account.. Exclusions: Institutional landholders; Families where a member paid income tax in the last assessment year.

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN). Required Documents: Official Identity Proof, Land ownership papers (Khasra / Khatauni), Active bank account passbook. Application Steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal or your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Click 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner. Enter state, district, and landholding details, then submit.

Scheme: Stand-Up India Scheme (Ministry of Finance). Benefits: Bank loans between ₹10,00,000 and ₹1,00,00,000 to SC/ST or women entrepreneurs for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading.. Exclusions: Non-greenfield (existing) business expansions; Male applicants belonging to General or OBC categories.

Scheme: Stand-Up India Scheme. Required Documents: Caste Certificate (for SC/ST applicants), Project Report and Business Incorporation Proof, Identity and Address Proof. Application Steps: Apply online through standupmitra.in or visit a scheduled commercial bank branch. Connect with a Stand-Up India Lead District Manager for handholding support. Submit project report for Composite Loan sanction.
